The '''Democratic Republic of Suzuharu''', commonly shortened to '''Suzuharu''', is a parliamentary republic associated with northern [[Erythrea]] in the extracted source material.

The Suzuharu country source is incomplete and contains several placeholders. This draft therefore preserves only the stable source facts needed for the 1994-back lore graph.

== Geography ==

The Erythrea source places the Democratic Republic of Suzuharu along a northern mountain range shared with Hwanboguri and identifies the [[Dongju River]] as a major waterway running through the country. The Suzuharu source also names the Gifu Gulf, Suzu Sea, and an overseas territory called the Isle of Yahui, but those locations need map review before publication.

The source names several neighboring or nearby states: Vinterholmian Chaonise, the [[Imperial Dynasty of Saochai]], Nijian Kingdom, Republic of Shangra-Li, Yaozhou Republic, and the [[Federated Syndicates of Veszprem]] as a maritime neighbor. Their exact borders and sea zones are not fixed in this draft.

== Government ==

Suzuharu is source-attested as a parliamentary republic with a president as head of state and a prime minister as head of government. The source names President Yi Mei and Prime Minister Lei Chin, but it does not provide dates for their offices. This draft does not assume they held office in 1994 until stronger chronology is reviewed.

The country source says Suzuharu has fifteen administrative divisions and one territory. This is preserved as a source fact, but the names and map positions of those divisions remain open.

== Source Limits ==

The source uses placeholder text for continent, area, and one neighboring sea. It also gives a population exceeding 100 million without a year. Those values should not be hardened as exact 1994 demographics or map facts until a later state-history and map pass confirms them.
